label: Identify one ancestral source from GOD_4 existence, finite reach and an actual root (inference)
rule: Inspect the last step of a path ending at a root and preserve its identified source
meaning: Choose a God g and an actual root n separately. A positive path from g into n would have a last incoming actual ground. Hence their path is empty and g equals n. This same argument applies to every actual root. Finite reach from this very g supplies all recipients' paths. The companion identifies any such named witness with any supplied root. GodExists is an input of this conditional application.
